overview: This Senate resolution congratulates the Oklahoma State University men's golf team, the Cowboys, for winning the 2025 NCAA Division I Men's Golf National Championship. It notes this was the team's 12th national title and first since 2018, won by defeating the University of Virginia in the final match-play round. It recognizes the team's young roster, several players who earned All-American honors, and head coach Alan Bratton, who was named national coach of the year. The Senate agreed to it on June 24, 2025.
for: Supporters say it is a simple way to honor student athletes and coaches for a national championship.
against: Critics say it is symbolic and does not change any law or spending.
